title: EURUSD M30 5-Year History Benchmark with Weekly Target Lock Removed
research_question: Does removing the weekly profit target lock (InpWeeklyTargetPct=0.0) on the remediated EURUSD champion configuration allow continuous trading across the full 5-year training history (2020.01.01 to 2024.12.31) and deliver robust positive net profit and controlled drawdown without multi-year dormancy?
hypothesis: Disabling the weekly profit target lock (InpWeeklyTargetPct: 5.0 -> 0.0) on the EURUSD champion settings (InpRequire618Rejection=true, InpNYClose=17, InpLondonOpen=8) will eliminate the artificial weekly trading halt and resolve the multi-year dormancy that affected EXP-0036 (which took only 24 trades before freezing in August 2020), enabling continuous 5-year execution with positive net expectancy and drawdown within prop firm limits (<8%).

facts: In EXP-0036 (EURUSD M30 Training 2020-2024), the strategy took only 24 trades and completely ceased trading on 2020.08.26 due to the ResetWeek() Monday comparison freeze bug.
Commit 91d075a repaired ResetWeek() to use calendar week index tracking.
In EXP-0068, candidate CAND-0040 validated EURUSD profitability on 2026 UNSEEN (+$143.24, PF 1.15, WR 82.4%, DD 4.97%) with InpRequire618Rejection=true and InpNYClose=17.
EURUSD with validated candidate settings has never been evaluated across the full 5-year training dataset (2020.01.01 to 2024.12.31).
inferences: Setting InpWeeklyTargetPct=0.0 completely bypasses [G3] Weekly profit lock (if(InpWeeklyTargetPct > 0)), preventing weekly trading lockouts.
Running the 5-year benchmark will establish the true multi-year baseline trade distribution, win rate, and drawdown of the champion preset.
evidence: EXP-0036 deal history shows first deal on 2020.02.20 and last deal on 2020.08.26, leaving 4 full years (Sept 2020 - Dec 2024) unexecuted.
EXP-0068 confirms InpRequire618Rejection=true and InpNYClose=17 deliver +$143.24 and 4.97% max DD on 2026 UNSEEN.

independent_variables.name: InpWeeklyTargetPct
independent_variables.rationale: Disables the weekly profit lock guard, ensuring uninterrupted trading every week throughout 2020-2024 without artificial weekly halts.

assumptions: The 5-year tick and bar data for EURUSD M30 is intact (100% history quality) across 2020.01.01 to 2024.12.31.
Removing the weekly target lock allows trade frequency to reflect true market conditions rather than arbitrary weekly cutoffs.
expected_observations: Total trades will be substantially higher than 24 (expected > 100 trades across 5 years).
Trading will be active across all 5 years (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024).
Net profit will be positive with Profit Factor > 1.20.
falsification_conditions: Total trades remain <= 30 (indicating trading lock or premature halt).
